qualification.details: Sr. Project Engineer: Full-time B. Tech in Computer Science or MCA with a minimum CGPA of 6.5 or 60% with minimum 5-year experience and minimum 1 year experience in Node JS. Desirable skills include Flutter / React Native, iOS app development, Microsoft Power Apps, Azure Database, and Experience of working with an IIT/NIT/IIIT institution of national repute. Sr. Project Assistant (Admin): Full-time Graduate Degree with a minimum CGPA of 6.5 or 60% with minimum work experience of 5 years out of which a minimum HR Sales experience of at least 2 years.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview.
Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification.

Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable).
Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification.
Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview.
Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities.
Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

content_sections.heading: IIT Delhi Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download IIT Delhi Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Sr. Project Engineer: Full-time B. Tech in Computer Science or MCA with a minimum CGPA of 6.5 or 60% with minimum 5-year experience and minimum 1 year experience in Node JS. Desirable skills include Flutter / React Native, iOS app development, Microsoft Power Apps, Azure Database, and Experience of working with an IIT/NIT/IIIT institution of national repute. Sr. Project Assistant (Admin): Full-time Graduate Degree with a minimum CGPA of 6.5 or 60% with minimum work experience of 5 years out of which a minimum HR Sales experience of at least 2 years.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Delhi Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Delhi (IIT Delhi) through its Industrial Research & Development Unit.

faq.question: Q2. What positions are available in IIT Delhi Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available positions are Sr. Project Engineer and Sr. Project Assistant (Admin) under project-based employment terms.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies available, which include 1 post for Sr. Project Engineer and 2 posts for Sr. Project Assistant (Admin).

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application and selection?
faq.answer: The application and selection process is through a Walk-in interview. Candidates need to report directly with the required documents.

faq.question: Q5. What is the date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in test or interview is scheduled to take place on 05 November 2026 with reporting starting at 10:00 AM.

faq.question: Q6. What qualifications are required for Sr. Project Engineer?
faq.answer: Candidates need a full-time B. Tech in Computer Science or MCA with a minimum CGPA of 6.5 or 60%, plus 5 years of experience including 1 year in Node JS.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for Sr. Project Engineer?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 60,750 to Rs. 79,260 per month plus HRA @30% depending on the pay structure and experience levels.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required?
faq.answer: No application fee has been specified in the official notification for attending the walk-in interview.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official website and notification?
faq.answer: You can check the official IRD recruitment website at http://ird.iitd.ac.in/rec to download the application form and view updates.

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You must bring a formal application on Form No. IRD/REC-4, educational marksheets and certificates, work experience proof, passport-size photographs, and original documents.
